name: General Mills - Fontana CA Distribution Center

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Confirmed General Mills Fontana distribution center, 11618 Mulberry Ave, Fontana CA 92337 (verified via Yelp, YellowPages, Superpages, Hyster GM plant locations list; red 'General Mills' sign visible at the entrance in Street View). A single very large rectangular DC warehouse (well over 1M sq ft) in the Southwest Industrial Park, running roughly N-S between Mulberry Ave (east) and a row of neighboring warehouses (west).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is a controlled driveway off Mulberry Ave on the building's east side, leading into the dock yard. Satellite (z20/z21) shows a chain-link gate panel across the truck lane plus painted STOP and directional lane arrows on the driveway pavement; Street View (2023-12) confirms a sliding chain-link gate at the property line. The entire Mulberry Ave frontage is otherwise enclosed by a perimeter wall/fence. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the truck entrance in any Street View heading - just the gate and lane markings. guardShack = false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with no guard booth, implying kiosk / call-box / app or remote check-in. remoteGs = true (medium confidence - listed uncertain).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door bank runs nearly the full length of the building's east face with dozens of trailers backed in (estimated ~55 dock positions). The west side is primarily a blank wall with a wide paved yard. dockDoors band 50+. Count is an estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large fenced trailer yard along the east dock face holds many trailers (~70 visible), a substantial share without tractors - dedicated drop yard. dropArea band 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks are concentrated in a single bank along the east face; no second distinct dock cluster on another building face. shipRcvSeparate = false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; this is a road-served distribution center. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense industrial park within the Fontana / Inland Empire metro, surrounded by big-box warehouses and adjacent residential subdivisions - Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The east-side truck driveway runs from Mulberry Ave deep into the dock yard before reaching the dock doors - deep approach, holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.staging: Wide paved yard along the building's west side provides additional interior maneuvering / staging space.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Mulberry Ave is a wide multi-lane arterial and the gate apron has ample paved depth, so a truck queue at the gate would not block the public road.
